issues: 背景是死平的近黑，霓虹大环的能量收束后画面里没有任何余韵
大环只做缩放，双弧缺口全程不动，高速缩小段没有速度感
落位刹车只有 6% 过冲，没有"盖章"的冲击读数
红色标语 #e0342c 和紫色霓虹撞色，字体回落到 Helvetica 800
lockup 整组偏左约 20px（图标左移量与字标宽度没对齐），标语却按全幅居中
changes: 深场改为冷色纵向渐变 + 暗角 + 原生像素颗粒，加一团随大环同步坍缩（半径 150→34）的紫色能量光晕，落位后回落成图标背后的微光
收束途中双弧减速自转 150°（outCubic），高速段按每帧缩放量叠上 1f/2f 两层缩放残影当运动模糊，静止时为 0
刹车回弹瞬间（t=0.28）放一圈细冲击波：细亮环 + 外圈柔光，扩散 32→140px 时变细变淡，只一次
字母滑入加 2.5px→0 的对焦模糊，字标换系统字体 760 重并收紧字距；标语改用与霓虹同色相的 #9d94ff，并上移 3px 落座
左移量 −68→−62px、字母行 50%−40→−32px，lockup 整组视觉居中；改用 zoom 栅格化保证字边锐利（md 同步）
issuesEn: The background was flat near-black; once the neon ring collapsed nothing lingered on screen
The ring only scaled, its gapped arcs never moved, and the fast shrink had no sense of speed
The landing brake was only a 6% overshoot with no stamp-like impact
The red tagline #e0342c clashed with the violet neon, and the font fell back to Helvetica 800
The lockup sat about 20px left of centre (icon shift not matched to wordmark width) while the tagline was centred to the frame
changesEn: Dark field is now a cool vertical gradient with vignette and native-pixel grain, plus a violet energy halo that collapses with the ring (radius 150→34) and settles into a faint glow behind the icon
The arcs spin 150° with outCubic deceleration while shrinking, and the fast section gets 1f/2f scale ghosts sized by per-frame scale change as motion blur, zero at rest
At the brake rebound (t=0.28) a single thin shockwave ring (bright core plus soft halo) expands 32→140px while thinning and fading
Letters slide in with a 2.5px→0 focus blur; wordmark in the system font at 760 weight with tighter tracking; tagline now #9d94ff from the neon's hue family, settling up 3px
Icon shift −68→−62px and letter row 50%−40→−32px so the lockup is optically centred; zoom rasterisation keeps glyph edges sharp (md updated)
